tal-a17-p01 · verses 17.1-17.10 · WITHHELD

atha bhairavatādātmyadāyinīṃ prakriyāṃ bruve / evaṃ maṇḍalakumbhāgniśiṣyasvātmasu pañcasu gṛhītvā vyāptimaikyena nyasyādhvānaṃ ca śiṣyagam / karmamāyāṇumalinatrayaṃ bāhau gale tathā śikhāyāṃ ca kṣipetsūtragranthiyogena daiśikaḥ / tasyātadrūpatābhānaṃ malo granthiḥ sa kīrtyate itipratītidārḍhyārthaṃ bahirgranthyupakalpanam / bāhū karmāspadaṃ viṣṇurmāyātmā galasaṃśritaḥ adhovahā śikhāṇutvaṃ tenetthaṃ kalpanā kṛtā / naraśaktiśivākhyasya trayasya bahubhedatām vaktuṃ tristriguṇaṃ sūtraṃ granthaye parikalpayet / tejojalānnatritayaṃ tredhā pratyekamapyadaḥ śrutyante ke@pyataḥ śuklakṛṣṇaraktaṃ prapedire / tato@gnau tarpitāśeṣamantre cidvyomamātrake sāmānyarūpe tattvānāṃ kramācchuddhiṃ samācaret / tatra svamantrayogena dharāmāvāhayetpurā iṣṭvā puṣpādibhiḥ sarpistilādyairatha tarpayet / tattattvavyāpikāṃ paścānmāyātattvādhidevatām māyāśaktiṃ svamantreṇāvāhyābhyarcya pratarpayet / āvāhane mātṛkārṇaṃ mālinyarṇaṃ ca pūjane

tal-a17-p02 · verses 17.11-17.20 · WITHHELD

kuryāditi guruḥ prāha svarūpāpyāyanadvayāt / tāro varṇo@tha saṃbuddhipadaṃ tvāmityataḥ param uttamaikayutaṃ karmapadaṃ dīpakamapyataḥ / tabhyaṃ nāma caturthyantaṃ tato@pyucitadīpakam ityūhamantrayogena tattatkarma pravartayet / āvāhanānantaraṃ hi karma sarvaṃ nigadyate āvāhanaṃ ca saṃbodhaḥ svasvabhāvavyavasthiteḥ / bhāvasyāhaṃmayasvātmatādātmyāveśyamānatā śāktī bhūmiśca saivoktā yasyāṃ mukhyāsti pūjyatā / abhātatvādabhedācca nahyasau nṛśivātmanoḥ jaḍābhāseṣu tattveṣu saṃvitsthityai tato guruḥ / āvāhanavibhaktiṃ prāk kṛtvā turyavibhaktitaḥ namaskārāntatāyogātpūrṇāṃ sattāṃ prakalpayet / tataḥ pūrṇasvabhāvatvaṃ tadrūpodrekayogataḥ dhyeyodreko bhaveddhyātṛprahvībhāvavaśādyataḥ / āvāhyeṣṭvā pratarpyeti śrīsvacchande nirūpitam anenaiva pathāneyamityasmadguravo jaguḥ / paratvena tu yatpūjyaṃ tatsvatantracidātmakam anavacchitprakāśatvānna prakāśyaṃ tu kutracit / tasya hyetatprapūjyatvadhyeyatvādi yadullaset

tal-a17-p03 · verses 17.21-17.30 · WITHHELD

tasyaiva tatsvatantratvaṃ yātidurghaṭakāritā / saṃbodharūpe tattasmin kathaṃ saṃbodhanā bhavet prakāśanāyāṃ na syātprakāśasya prakāśatā / saṃbodhanavibhaktyaiva vinā karmādiśaktitām svātantryāttaṃ darśayituṃ tatrohamimamācaret / devamāvāhayāmīti tato devāya dīpakam prāgyuktyā pūrṇatādāyi namaḥsvāhādikaṃ bhavet / nutiḥ pūrṇatvamagnīndusaṃghaṭṭāpyāyatā param āpyāyakaṃ ca procchālaṃ vauṣaḍādi pradīpayet / tatra bāhye@pi tādātmyaprasiddhaṃ karma codyate yadi karmapadaṃ tanno gururabhyūhayetkvacit / anābhāsitatadvastubhāsanāya niyujyate mantraḥ kiṃ tena tatra syātsphuṭaṃ yatrāvabhāsi tat / tena prokṣaṇasaṃsekajapādividhiṣu dhruvam tatkarmābhyūhanaṃ kuryātpratyuta vyavadhātṛtām / bahistathātmatābhāve kāryaṃ karmapadohanam tṛptāvāhutihutabhukpāśaploṣacchidādiṣu / yatroddiṣṭe vidhau paścāttadanantaiḥ kriyātmakaiḥ aṃśaiḥ sādhyaṃ na tatroho dīkṣaṇādividhiṣviva / tataḥ śiṣyasya tattattvasthāne@streṇa pratāḍanam

tal-a17-p04 · verses 17.31-17.40 · WITHHELD

kṛtvātha śivahastena hṛdayaṃ parimarśayet / tataḥ svanāḍīmārgeṇa hṛdayaṃ prāpya vai śiśoḥ śiṣyātmanā sahaikatvaṃ gatvādāya ca taṃ hṛdā / puṭitaṃ haṃsarūpākhyaṃ tatra saṃhāramudrayā kuryādātmīyahṛdayasthitamapyavabhāsakam / śiṣyadehasya tejobhī raśmimātrāviyogataḥ svabandhasthānacalanāt svatantrasthānalābhataḥ / svakarmāparatantratvātsarvatrotpattimarhati tenātmahṛdayānītaṃ prākkṛtvā pudgalaṃ tataḥ / māyāyāṃ taddharātattvaśarīrāṇyasya saṃsṛjet tatrāsya garbhādhānaṃ ca yuktaṃ puṃsavanādibhiḥ / garbhaniṣkrāmaparyantairekāṃ kurvīta saṃskriyām jananaṃ bhogabhoktṛtvaṃ militvaikātha saṃskriyā / tato@sya teṣu bhogeṣu kuryāttanmayatāṃ layam tatastattattvapāśānāṃ vicchedaṃ samupācaret / saṃskārāṇāṃ catuṣke@sminnaparāṃ ca parāparām mantrāṇāṃ pañcadaśakaṃ parāṃ vā yojayetkramāt / pivanyādyaṣṭakaṃ śastrādikaṃ ṣaṭkaṃ parā tathā iti pañcadaśaite syuḥ kramāllīnatvasaṃskṛtau / aparāmantramuktvā prāgamukātmana ityatha

tal-a17-p05 · verses 17.41-17.50 · WITHHELD

garbhādhānaṃ karomīti punarmantraṃ tameva ca / svāhāntamuccarandadyādāhutitritayaṃ guruḥ paraṃ parāparāmantramamukātmana ityatha / jātasya bhogabhoktṛtvaṃ karomyatha parāparām ante svāheti proccārya vitarettisra āhutīḥ / uccārya pivanīmantramamukātmana ityatha bhoge layaṃ karomīti punarmantraṃ tameva ca / svāhāntamāhutīstisro dadyādājyatilādibhiḥ eṣa eva vamanyādau vidhiḥ pañcadaśāntake / pūrvaṃ parātmakaṃ mantramamukātmana ityatha pāśācchedaṃ karomīti parāmantraḥ punastataḥ / huṃ svāhā phaṭ samuccārya dadyāttisro@pyathāhutīḥ saṃskārāṇāṃ catuṣke@sminye mantrāḥ kathitā mayā / teṣu karmapadātpūrvaṃ dharātattvapadaṃ vadet tato dharātattvapatimāmantryeṣṭvā pratarpya ca / śivābhimānasaṃrabdho gururevaṃ samādiśet tattveśvara tvayā nāsya putrakasya śivājñayā / pratibandhaḥ prakartavyo yātuḥ padamanāmayam tato yadi samīheta dharātattvāntarālagam / pṛthak śodhayituṃ mantrī bhuvanādyadhvapañcakam

tal-a17-p06 · verses 17.51-17.60 · WITHHELD

aparāmantrataḥ prāgvattisrastisrastadāhutīḥ / dadyātpuraṃ śodhayāmītyūhayuktaṃ prasannadhīḥ evaṃ kalāmantrapadavarṇeṣvapi vicakṣaṇaḥ / tisrastisro hutīrdadyāt pṛthak sāmastyato@pivā tataḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ dattvā parayā vauṣaḍantayā / aparāmantrataḥ śiṣyamuddhṛtyātmahṛdaṃ nayet yadā tvekena śuddhena tadantarbhāvacintanāt / na pṛthak śodhayettattvanāthasaṃśravaṇātparam tadā pūrṇāṃ vitīryāṇumutkṣipyātmani yojayet / tātsthyātmasaṃsthyayogāya tayaivāparayāhutīḥ sakarmapadayā dadyāditi kecittu manvate / anye tu guravaḥ prāhurbhāvanāmayamīdṛśam nātra bāhyāhutirdeyā daiśikasya pṛthak punaḥ / dadyādvā yadi no doṣaḥ syādupāyaḥ sa bhāvane evaṃ prāktanatātsthyātmasaṃsthatve yojayedguruḥ / tataḥ śiṣyahṛdaṃ neyaḥ sa ātmā tāvato@dhvanaḥ śuddhastaddārḍhyasiddhyai ca pūrṇā syātparayā punaḥ / mahāpāśupataṃ pūrvaṃ vilomasya viśuddhaye juhomi punarastreṇa vauṣaḍanta iti kṣipet / punaḥ pūrṇāṃ tato māyāmabhyarcyātha visarjayet

tal-a17-p07 · verses 17.61-17.70 · WITHHELD

dharātattvaṃ viśuddhaṃ sajjalena śuddharūpiṇā / bhāvayenmiśritaṃ vāri śuddhiyogyaṃ tato bhavet tathā tattatpurātattvamiśraṇāduttarottaram / sarvā śivībhavettattvāvalī śuddhānyathā pṛthak pṛthaktvaṃ ca malo māyābhidhānastasya saṃbhave / karmakṣaye@pi no muktirbhavedvidyeśvarādivat tato@pi jalatattvasya vahnau vyomni cidātmake / āhvānādyakhilaṃ yāvattejasyasya vimaśraṇam evaṃ kramātkalātattve śuddhe pāśaṃ bhujāśritam / chindyātkalā hi sā kiṃcitkartṛtvonmīlanātmikā karmākhyamalajṛmbhātmā taṃ ca granthiṃ srugagragam / pūrṇāhutyā samaṃ vahnimantratejasi nirdahet mantro hi viśvarūpaḥ sannupāśrayavaśāttathā / vyaktarūpastato vahnau pāśaploṣavidhāyakaḥ pluṣṭo līnasvabhāvo@sau pāśastaṃ prati śambhuvat / parameśamahātejaḥśeṣamātratvamaśnute karmapāśe@tra hotavye pūrṇayāsya śubhāśubham / aśubhaṃ vā bhavadbhūtaṃ bhāvi vātha samastakam dahāmi phaṭtrayaṃ vauṣaḍiti pūrṇāṃ vinikṣipet / evaṃ māyāntasaṃśuddhau kaṇṭhapāśaṃ ca homayet

pūrṇasya tasya māyākhyaṃ pāśabhedaprathātmakam / dahāmi phaṭtrayaṃ vauṣaḍiti pūrṇāṃ kṣipedguruḥ nirbījā yadi kāryā tu tadātraivāparāṃ kṣipet / pūrṇāṃ samayapāśākhyabījadāhapadānvitām gurau deve tathā śāstre bhaktiḥ kāryāsya nahyasau / samayaḥ śaktipātasya svabhāvo hyeṣa no pṛthak māyānte śuddhimāyāte vāgīśī yā purābhavat / māyā śaktimayī saiva vidyāśaktitvamaśnute tacchuddhavidyāmāhūya vidyāśaktiṃ niyojayet / evaṃ krameṇa saṃśuddhe sadāśivapade@pyalam śikhāṃ granthiyutāṃ chittvā malamāṇavakaṃ dahet / yato@dhikārabhogākhyau dvau pāśau tu sadāśive ityuktyāṇavapāśo@tra māyīyastu niśāvadhiḥ / śiṣyo yathocitaṃ snāyādācāmeddaiśikaḥ svayam āṇavākhye vinirdagdhe hyadhovāhiśikhāmale / tataḥ prāguktasakalaprameyaṃ paricintayan śiṣyadehādimātmīyadehaprāṇādiyojitam / kṛtvātmadehaprāṇāderviśvamantaranusmaret uktaprakriyayā caivaṃ dṛḍhabuddhirananyadhīḥ / prāṇasthaṃ deśakālādhvayugaṃ prāṇaṃ ca śaktigam
